title: FHE Rock Paper ✂️
tagline: Rock Paper Scissors game with secret encryption powered by FHE
description:
Rock Paper Scissors is a fully onchain game with secret encryption, deployed on Fhenix fhEVM.
It leverages the power of Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) to ensure on-chain privacy, allowing for hidden actions & draw.
Game setup & commit-reveal scheme to ensure people can't & won't cheat.
how_its_made:
Rock Paper Scissors is a fully onchain game with secret encryption, deployed on Fhenix fhEVM.
It leverages the power of Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) to ensure on-chain privacy, allowing for hidden actions. 

I've been the first person to implement (at least publicly) WAGMI for FHE, I hope my code will be useful for future implementations.
